title: Hearty Irish Pasta
description: A comforting and flavorful pasta dish inspired by Irish cuisine, featuring feta cheese and hearty ingredients.

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: High-quality feta is essential for this recipe

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter is best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Add fresh parsley for a pop of color and freshness

ingredients.name: Heavy cream
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality heavy cream for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to bring out the flavors

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the crumbled feta cheese and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until melted and smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the all-purpose flour to thicken the sauce.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the feta sauce until well coated.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
